ranked.headline: Single-cell models link chromatin accessibility and spatial context to gene regulation
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks and extends single-cell RNA, ATAC, and spatial integration for regulatory and perturbation inference.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned models predict antibody interfaces, developability, and ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair antibody sequence and structure inputs with explicit conditioning to test which features drive prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned models couple histology, spatial omics and clinical outcomes in cancer
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and open resources now test whether learned representations of tumor tissue and single-cell data predict clinical outcomes.

ranked.headline: Structure modeling maps interaction interfaces, oligomerization, disorder-linked contacts
ranked.summary: A benchmark of 439 heterodimers finds MSA depth, not pairing, drives AlphaFold-Multimer and AF3 complex prediction gains.

ranked.headline: Public MS data resources and tools for peptide matching, metadata, and visualization
ranked.summary: Large reprocessed MS resources and tools that automate metadata curation address reuse and benchmarking needs in public proteomics.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models infer hidden parameters from sparse immune and delivery measurements
ranked.summary: Simulation-trained and theory-based estimators are being paired with sparse experimental readouts to quantify hidden immune and delivery parameters.

ranked.headline: Supervised Models Predict Molecular Binding, Toxicity, pKa and Inhibitor Prioritization
ranked.summary: Ensemble, read-across and fused-representation models now extend prediction of binding, pKa and toxicity while adding simulation and benchmark validation.

ranked.headline: LLM agents draw on documentation, literature graphs, and containers for bioinformatics…
ranked.summary: Recent April 2026 preprints show agentic bioinformatics tools moving from parametric recall toward explicit, verifiable resources and sandboxed execution.

ranked.headline: Tailored representations for dimensionality reduction and sequence encoding in biology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers revisit dimensionality reduction and sequence encoding with metrics and transforms designed for specific biological data types.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models pursue batch-robust representations for perturbation prediction
ranked.summary: Single-cell foundation models and generative methods are now tested on whether embeddings generalize across batches, modalities, and perturbations.

ranked.headline: Leakage control and multi-model benchmarks test ML claims in biological data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark protein, DNA, TB and ancient DNA classifiers, showing evaluation design determines which performance claims are supportable.

ranked.headline: Long-read and unmapped-read analyses reveal sequence missed by reference pipelines
ranked.summary: Reference-anchored pipelines miss megabases of sequence in South Asian genomes, prompting long-read and assembly-based recovery methods.

ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks for differential analysis of complex and temporal omics designs
ranked.summary: Designed contrasts and principled significance testing are now applied to sparse, high-dimensional, and time-resolved omics measurements.

ranked.headline: Biomolecular models transferred to polypeptoids and non-canonical cyclic peptides
ranked.summary: Non-canonical peptides and polypeptoids fall outside original parameter ranges, prompting transfer of energetic and learned models to these chemistries.

ranked.headline: Graph learning models protein units, protease cleavage, and drug-target binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply structure-aware graph models to protease specificity, protein units, and drug-target explainability at scale.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and language models steered by RL and 3D constraints for molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair diffusion and LLM generators with RL steering and pocket or 3D context for de novo molecular design.

ranked.headline: Computational tools automate detection and quantification in imaging and omics datasets
ranked.summary: Recent papers package automated detection and quantification into reusable tools for imaging and omics data.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and regression methods prioritize causal genes under correlated phenotypes
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases now supply cell-type context for gene prioritization, while Bayesian fine mapping addresses correlated phenotypes in phenome-wide TWAS.

ranked.headline: Network coupling and perturbation readouts map feedback in gene and metabolic states
ranked.summary: Recent papers couple gene regulation, metabolism, and spectral data into network models that quantify feedback and perturbation effects.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics links gene expression to tissue architecture in organs and brain
ranked.summary: Unified multi-organ datasets and imaging-anchored atlases now enable volumetric and developmental spatial analyses of tissue organization.

ranked.headline: Stochastic and unconventional noise sources extend models of neuronal excitability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add stochastic synapses, proton tunneling, and murburn electron-holding potentials to conductance-based models of firing and Ca2+ release.

ranked.headline: Single-cell tools address clustering, RNA velocity stability, and allelic imbalance
ranked.summary: Population-scale single-cell datasets and RNA velocity stability concerns motivate scalable, quantitatively validated processing methods.

ranked.headline: Inferring kinetic and dynamical parameters from single-cell and stochastic reaction data
ranked.summary: Time-series single-cell data and stochastic reaction models now support direct inference of division, velocity, and rate parameters from data.

ranked.headline: Structure-based pocket and docking methods are expanding ligand discovery benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs protein pocket geometry and learned cofolding models with large-scale docking datasets to improve virtual screening evaluation.

ranked.headline: Deterministic and multi-view similarity methods scale partitioning of biomolecular data
ranked.summary: Recent methods target trajectory and sequence data where pairwise distance matrices become computationally prohibitive at scale.

ranked.headline: Computational models and classifiers for microbial genomes, microbiomes and phage hosts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add QIIME 2 plugins, protein language model host prediction and validated Cryptococcus metabolic models to microbial analysis.

ranked.headline: Genomic and protein language models tested for regulatory and disordered-region design
ranked.summary: Sequence-only language models are being tested for regulatory and disordered-region capacity, where gains over baselines remain limited.

ranked.headline: MD and AI/ML suggest nsp10 activates SARS-CoV-2 nsp16 via a hydrophobic latch
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 work pairs nsp16 activation mechanics with HIV Tat-inhibitor modeling and viral siRNA/ASO design tooling.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking somatic callers and rewriting VCF and annotation tools for speed
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair clinical benchmarking of somatic callers with speed-focused rewrites of VCF filtering and effect prediction.

ranked.headline: Protonation and conformational state control enzyme selectivity and catalytic reset
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a QM/MM study show protonation and hydration switches tune conformation-dependent function in enzymes and motor proteins.

ranked.headline: Temporal scale, noise and predictability shape mosquito-borne outbreak structure
ranked.summary: Recent models show R0 alone fails to predict arboviral outbreaks, with temporal scale and stochasticity governing transmission structure.

ranked.headline: Scalable tools for ortholog, synteny, and multi-sequence alignment across genomes
ranked.summary: Updated and new tools target orthology, synteny-based duplication history, and large-scale protein alignment accuracy and scalability.

ranked.headline: Genetic variation and chromatin context shape regulatory element activity across tissues
ranked.summary: Multi-tissue and cross-species datasets now allow noncoding regulatory units to be read against genetic variation, methylation, and 3D genome context.

ranked.headline: Interactive platforms surface gene hierarchy, sample trendlines, and variant effects
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package integrated molecular and evidence layers into queryable interfaces, moving beyond fixed analyses and single-readout summaries.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models of Golgi cisternae and cohesin loop extrusion kinetics
ranked.summary: Three April 2026 preprints apply dynamical, kinetic, and stochastic models to organelle, chromatin, and bacterial cell-lineage dynamics.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict TF binding, 3D genome, and accessibility across species
ranked.summary: Recent work extends sequence- and accessibility-based models to TF binding, cross-species accessibility, and cell-type 3D genome organization.

ranked.headline: Graph databases now store and compute population genomic variant statistics
ranked.summary: Two 2026 preprints propose graph databases as a unified layer for population genomic storage, provenance, and summary statistics computation.
